title: Efficient DNN-Powered Software with Fair Sparse Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating face gender classification performance and fairness discrepancies using Class-Wise Variance (CWV) and Maximum Class-wise Discrepancy (MCD) on the CelebA and LFW datasets.
Measuring performance variations across underrepresented age groups (such as children, babies, and individuals over the age of 80) using the LFW dataset in an imbalanced data setting.
Comparing text sentiment classification performance on the Moji dataset between tweets written in 'Standard American English' and 'African American English'.

Calculating Class-Wise Variance (CWV) and Maximum Class-wise Discrepancy (MCD) to measure generic performance variations across different object categories in computer vision datasets like CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet.
